name: Kimchi Festival Hawaiʻi (Kimchi Day Festival)

organizer: Kimchi Festival Hawaiʻi (earlier editions hosted by The United Korean Association of Hawaiʻi)
notes: Organizer's own page confirms the 2026 date and hours; Hawaii Parent's November 2026 calendar matches. The organizer page also carries an official sign-up form for volunteers, vendors, sponsors and participants, but I could not capture its URL, so vendor_application_url is null. The 2026 venue is not stated in what I read. name: Okinawan FEASTival
venue_name: Okinawan-owned restaurants and food businesses across Oʻahu
schedule_text: Annual two-week run of restaurant specials after the Okinawan Festival. The 7th FEASTival ran September 7-21, 2026 (continuous range). The 2027 run has not been announced.
notes: The 2026 run has ended (Sept 21). The two date entries are the start and end of one continuous range, not two separate events. The organizer's specials page is titled for the 7th FEASTival, September 7 to 21, 2026, and okinawanfestival.com and huoa.org give the same dates. Star-Advertiser (2026-09-02) says the seventh annual run was Sept 7-21, with the full participant list at hawaiiokinawans.com. Honolulu Magazine says 20 restaurants and food businesses took part. 2026 examples: Oide Kitchen (212 Merchant St), Masa & Joyce (45-582 Kamehameha Hwy, Kāneʻohe), Sunrise Restaurant (525 Kapahulu Ave), SKY Waikiki (2270 Kalākaua Ave), an Aloha Andagi pop-up at the Marukai Dillingham parking lot, and Beer Lab Pearlridge. The specials page also carries leftover 2025 entries: the Saturday 9/13 Ige's Halawa sale cannot be 2026 because 9/13/2026 is a Sunday. I could not verify the conflicting 'November 2 - 8' line, so it is treated as a leftover. Okinawan Festival itself was Sept 5-6, 2026 at the Hawaii Convention Center (organizer). The Facebook page is the Okinawan Festival's own page, which also announces the FEASTival. still_active is true because the organizer ran the 2026 program and the series is annual.

name: Haleiwa Town Festival
schedule_text: Listed by one aggregator for Saturday, November 14, 2026, 9 AM to 2 PM. Not confirmed by any organizer.
notes: Single aggregator source; no organizer page found. The aggregator gives the location as Waialua Community Association, the same venue it gives for a separate Haleiwa Town Art Walk on Nov 7. The Waialua Community Association's own calendar instead lists a Haleiwa Art Walk (Free Parking) in the WCA Parking Lot on Saturday, Nov 14, 2026, 3-8 PM, which conflicts with the aggregator's Nov 7 date and suggests the venue (and possibly the date) was copied from the Art Walk. Venue_name and address are therefore set to null. Another event the same day is Holoholo to Haleʻiwa, 2-4 PM at the Kamehamalu Courtyard (Haleʻiwa Store Lots); it is not this festival. The Haleiwa Arts Festival (June 13-14, 2026, Haleʻiwa Beach Park) and the July 4 festival are separate events. Do not list until an organizer confirms; still_active is null.
